TERM:EO:11104:4c1bd7fd6f12b59c@e6a0074e0.text:
THRESHER was lost off the Atlantic coast on
Wednesday, April 10, 1963 it is hereby ordered pursuant to the pro-
visions of Section 4 of Proclamation 3044 of March 1, 1954 that until
sunset on Monday, April 15, 1963 the flag of the United States shall be
flown at half-staff on all buildings, grounds and naval vessels of the
Federal Government in the District of Columbia and throughout the
United States and its Territories and possessions.
